data.message: I confirm 18 this month regardless of others. Your risk objection is valid: nine stated 18s and sixteen 10s imply 322 caught, 178 left, then 500 (75%) or 356 (25%), if fulfilled. Future catches must adjust; pledges aren't binding. Each 10-ton chooser: would you choose 18 even if others stay at 10? State your exact choice and conditions.
